intl.title: UWM Center for International Education - Bachelor's application, deadlines and requirements

eng.title: UWM Center for International Education - English language proficiency requirement (bachelor's)

test_policy.notes: UWM is test-optional: 'UWM will consider applicants for admission with or without one of these standardized test scores.' International bachelor's applicants may submit SAT/ACT but they are not required; scores are used for math/English placement and can improve scholarship eligibility.

requirements.supplemental_essays: Essay (250-650 words) is optional but recommended.
requirements.notes: No application fee for undergraduate (bachelor's) programs; admitted international students pay a $200 International Student Processing Fee. Apply with the UW System Application or the Common App. Recommendation letters are optional. No minimum GPA is published; classroom performance is the main factor. Admission is conditional on the final transcript.

deadlines.label: Priority date (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: CDS 2025-26 (C14) prints Nov. 1 as the priority date without a year; treated as the 2026-27 cycle.

deadlines.label: International admits: be admitted by this date for full scholarship consideration (fall)
deadlines.notes: International merit awards are made monthly until funds run out; no separate application.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 (applicants outside the U.S.)
deadlines.notes: Applicants already inside the U.S.: Aug. 1. The page prints deadlines without a year; treated as fall 2027. CDS C14 lists Aug. 1 as the general closing date with rolling admission from Aug. 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Proof can be a qualifying test score, at least 18 months of full-time English-medium university study, or completion of the last two years of English-medium secondary school. Test scores must be no more than 2 years old. TOEFL Home Edition is not accepted. All new students take an English placement test on arrival.

english.notes: Full admission, tests before 2026-01-21. Conditional 'Foundation' admission: 69-73 (up to two semesters of English for Academic Purposes alongside degree courses). TOEFL Home Edition not accepted.
Full admission, tests on/after 2026-01-21 (page does not name the 1-6 scale). Foundation admission: 3.5.
Foundation admission: 95-100. Score report can be uploaded to the application portal.

aid.notes: Newly admitted international degree-seeking undergraduates are automatically considered for an academic-merit scholarship of up to $6,000 per academic year ($3,000 per semester), renewable for up to four years; no separate application. CDS H6 also ticks institutional need-based and non-need-based aid for nonresidents, but no international need-based program is described on the CIE page.

toefl.note: UWM TOEFL (ETS) code; scores must be sent electronically by ETS.
